component.name: Polaris Studio
component.summary: Local AI music and pixel-art generation workstation

description.p: Polaris Studio is a private, offline AI music and image-generation desktop application powered by GGML. Describe a song or create a detailed pixel-art asset for a local game project. Runs entirely on your local machine — no cloud, no subscription, no browser.

Features a native Qt 6 desktop interface with library management, reference-song analysis, Pixel Lab, model downloader, and system resource monitoring. Audio and image runtimes use Vulkan for GPU acceleration when available.
Adds proportional maximized-window scaling and removes obsolete Windows launch scripts from the Linux-only project.
Adds independent 250 ms host and AMD GPU telemetry, four grouped gauges, smooth instrument-style needles, and responsive compact-window scaling.
Fixed the IPC connection lifecycle so the local server transitions from booting to running.
